episodes.synopsis: Young Kokona Otori has always dreamed of being a star—a World Dai Star! She’s been told she doesn’t have what it takes, but a chance to show her stuff in front of the legendary all-female acting troupe SIRIUS may change everything!
episodes.title: The Girl with Dreams

episodes.synopsis: If Kokona thought making it into the SIRIUS acting troupe would be the hardest part of achieving her dream, she was wrong! She’s already got her next big challenge ahead of her—landing her first role!
episodes.title: Copying Someone Else

episodes.synopsis: Preparing for her first role has got Kokona doing some soul-searching. Can a little bit of self-discovery help her become someone else on the stage?
episodes.title: Our First Play

episodes.synopsis: Kokona may have made it through her first play, but now the other girls are looking for answers. Just who is Shizuka?
episodes.title: Once Upon a Time

episodes.synopsis: SIRIUS is planning their next production and to everyone's surprise, Kokona is picked as the lead rather than Yae.
episodes.title: A Wish

episodes.synopsis: Kokona is completely absorbed in her first lead role, which may not end up being a good thing for her performance...
episodes.title: No One Is Looking at Me

episodes.synopsis: Even if Kokona can figure out the trick to mastering her first lead role, can she pull it off in time to save the show?
episodes.title: Believe in Yourself

episodes.synopsis: It’s time for SIRIUS’s annual special theatrical showcase... Why does everyone look so on edge about the performance?
episodes.title: Romeo and Juliet

episodes.synopsis: SIRIUS is on summer break, and Sasuga seems to have taken up a new hobby.
episodes.title: World Dai Star

episodes.synopsis: The girls all prepare for their next major audition—for the titular role in SIRIUS’s adaptation of The Phantom of the Opera.
episodes.title: Everyone's Phantoms

episodes.synopsis: Shizuka takes Kokona on a nostalgic journey to remind her why she wanted to become a World Dai Star in the first place.
episodes.title: Our Promise

episodes.synopsis: It's finally time for the big show. Can Kokona dig deep enough to save her dreams and maybe Shizuka's too?
episodes.title: The Two of Us Together
